public_pattern: [OPUS-5.5] Backend noir_public_pattern only: every accepted or constraint cell reports contract {version:4, package:result_v4_k1|k2_n16_p3_r4_f0_d10}; any other version or package is a fallback failure. Native refusals report rejection_scope empty_graph or native_support. Non-native negatives must be direct constraint rejections with reconstructed public_triples; attacks that touch the unused pattern-zero opening fail rather than count.
terms: Canonical N-Triples term strings; null denotes an unbound SELECT cell. Variable names omit ?. No lossy numeric or per-row blank-node normalization.
dataset: Optional {ntriples, nquads, named_graphs}; triples is the independent default-graph triple array when available. Preserve source bytes and graph catalog.
expected_result: Existing exact-evaluator CanonicalResult JSON: Select{variables,order:Bag|Sequence,rows}, Ask(boolean), or Graph{ntriples}.
nonce: nonce_id is a deterministic test identifier, not entropy. Derive backend nonce from the complete job identity using a domain-separated hash; use a fresh verifier nonce store per job and one reused store for the replay control.
acceptance: Native/constraint outcomes have proof_count=verified_count=0. A real positive requires actual cryptographic proving and independent verification (counts at least 1/1), retained proof artifacts, and proof_verifier stage. Missing tools, process crashes, timeouts and arbitrary panics are errors, never successful relation rejection.
negatives: Record honest support refusal, actual unsatisfied constraint, and verifier rejection of a genuine candidate separately. A support refusal alone does not discharge the required malicious-prover attack lane. Real negative jobs may have zero verified_count and positive proof_count when a deliberately weaker proof is rejected by the required verifier.
unsupported: Only a documented profile exclusion with a stable reason is unsupported. Missing adapters, parse bugs and infrastructure failures fail the run. Configured and executed coverage denominators remain separate.
toolchain_identity: Non-native Noir adapter configuration must pin exact nargo and bb executable SHA-256 and complete stdout/stderr version outputs; retained in adapters.json.
expected_rejection: Imported negative contract: category(capacity|profile|parse), phase(admission|dataset|evaluation), and exact cause or diagnostic for every capacity control. capacity-expectations.json binds original fixture bytes to intended numeric, temporal or row-limit failures. Unknown originals require classification. The adapter must not read expectations to classify its own error.
rejection: Observed exact-model classification {category,phase,diagnostic}. Unknown/combined model errors are observed:error, never a successful capacity negative. No substring-based inference.
expectation_oracle: Optional version-specific independently derived oracle. The case retains the unchanged original fixture/query/dataset and original version golden; a newer profile positive is selected only by an explicit backend_expectations record pinned to the exact original fixture and dataset hashes. No implicit promotion to other versions.
